findings.text: The raw per processor try update family covers narrow widths plus wide sixty four and one hundred twenty eight bit widths, each width offered in two build alternatives with one alternative using a fallback helper tied to the matching raw compare helper and the other using a shared generic try helper.
The raw per processor compare family covers the same narrow and wide widths with each member delegating to a shared generic compare helper for the current processor.

The checked current processor accessors provide sized read, store, add, bitwise conjunction, bitwise disjunction, add returning updated value, and exchange operations for narrow widths, each delegating to a matching generic helper with store using assignment and the others using their natural update meaning.

The checked current processor compare family provides width specific compare members delegating to a shared generic compare helper, plus width specific try members in two build alternatives with one alternative using a fallback helper tied to the matching checked compare member and the other using a shared generic try helper.

Generic per processor headers act as thin forwarding shims that preserve width dispatch while centralizing effect in generic helpers, and the per processor qualifier is defined empty so it adds no type decoration in this configuration.
The resilient queue lock object holds a union giving two views of one word, one atomic view for modifying access and one plain thirty two bit view for locked state observation.
The BPF resident lock wrapper holds one thirty two bit value and requests alignment equal to that of the resilient queue lock object.
Deadlock tracking state per processor holds a count plus a fixed array of opaque lock pointers with capacity of thirty one entries.
Maximum tracked nested locks per processor is thirty one.
Default resilient spin timeout is one quarter second measured in nanoseconds.
Shared memory attach alignment equals the paging granularity.

Initial limits leave processor time, file size, data, resident set, address space, file locks and realtime runtime unlimited, give stack a bounded soft value with unlimited hard value, give core zero soft with unlimited hard, leave process count and pending signals at zero, size open files and locked memory and message queue from their configured defaults, and leave nice and realtime priority at zero.

Compatibility mode one permits read, write, exit and signal return, expressed both as thirty two bit aliases and native aliases, with a helper returning a static list of the thirty two bit set terminated by a negative sentinel.
Containment is true when a candidate address range lies fully inside a bounding interval, overlap is true when ranges intersect, and init helpers apply those tests to the init bounds.

Core data is recognized via data and block storage ranges, read only and read only after init via their dedicated ranges, init text via its range, executable text via its range, and overall kernel membership via main text to end or init begin to end.

Function descriptor handling maps descriptor pointers to code addresses by identity for normal and kernel cases, uses a descriptor type holding one unsigned address field, and exposes a predicate reporting whether descriptor support is enabled.

Acquisition records the target in per processor tracking before attempting an acquiring compare on the fast path and enters a queued slow path on contention, with an alternate build that records then uses a test and set path.
Release clears the lock word with release ordering before clearing the matching tracking entry and decrementing the per processor depth, preserving visibility for interrupt observers.
Raw wrappers set the lock to unlocked, suppress preemption with optional interrupt save across acquisition, undo that suppression when acquisition fails, and restore suppression state after release.

Insertion increments per processor depth and stores the lock when within capacity, while unwind and unlock clear the top slot when within capacity and decrement, with barriers keeping entry and count coherent for remote readers.

An attempt progresses from idle to recorded to locked on fast success or to waiting on contention, then to held on success or back to idle with unwind on failure, while release progresses from held to unlocked to idle.
Depth beyond capacity still advances the count without storing a pointer, so later unwind must tolerate absent entries until depth returns within range.

Interrupts arriving between compare and table update or between table clear and lock clear can hide self acquisition, which motivates recording before attempting, clearing the lock word prior to clearing tracking, and barrier use on unwind to avoid false cross lock reports.
Virtual resilience helpers report disabled and immediate success, showing no extra virtual handling in this build.

Small generic shims alias filesystem identity, run soft interrupts through the core handler, switch contexts while publishing the prior task, and provide header guards with an empty per processor qualifier.
Context switch entry delegates to the architecture switch and yields the previous context, and soft interrupt entry runs the core handler on an owned stack.
The resilient lock type name resolves to either the queued lock type or the local resilient structure depending on build configuration.
